messages:
incident-bot: ALERT p99 spike detected on /v1/chat/completions route 'chat-prod-v2' (model=gpt-multi-small). p99=1400ms (>alert threshold 900ms). 1200 events in last 5m.

mia (oncall): ack. i'm on it. starting quick triage — pulling recent deploys and autoscaler events.

alex (ml-runtime): no deploys flagged in last 45m. I see KV cache miss rate up 3x for that route (possible cache pressure after long seqs). model latency per-region shows eu-west spike.

raj (eng-sre): grabbing infra metrics. Instances in eu-west at 95% GPU mem; autoscaler didn't spin up because of packed-instance gating. likely capacity bottleneck + long context.

sam (prod-ops): pushing a quick temporary mitigation: routing 25% of traffic for chat-prod-v2 -> chat-prod-small (lower-cost variant) via canary rule. executing now.

dev-bot: run: ./ops route-change --from chat-prod-v2 --to chat-prod-small --pct 25 --canary-id canary-227890. Status: SUCCESS.

mia (oncall): nice. canary live. monitoring p99 now. also temporarily raising p99 alert threshold for chat-prod-v2 to 1400ms to reduce noise while mitigation runs. Will record change.

raj (eng-sre): please post the exact alert change command so we can revert in postmortem.

mia (oncall): alert change: `terraform apply -var 'route=chat-prod-v2' -var 'metric=p99' -var 'threshold_ms=1400' modules/alerts/` — applied at 2278901290 UTC by mia.

alex (ml-runtime): canary is behaving: p99 for chat-prod-v2 down from 1400->980 over 4m; overall total p99 for route group is 870 now.

jordan (support): flagging impacted customers: 2 enterprise customers on eu-west reported degraded experiences; pinged account reps. no escalations yet.

mia (oncall): handoff notes for next oncall (raj): mitigations done: canary routing (25%) -> chat-prod-small, temporary alert threshold bump p99 900->1400ms, canary id canary-227890. Watch for regressions in eu-west and KV cache miss rates. If p99 > 1200ms for >10m, escalate to pagers.

raj (eng-sre): ack handoff. I will keep an eye for 30m. creating dashboard panel to track per-route p95/p99, cache-miss, gpu-mem, and canary traffic percent.

sam (prod-ops): created dashboard: https://console.redwood/instrumentation/d/alerts/canary-227890 (panel id 452). Added alert rule `canary-traffic-deviation` to detect <20% traffic to canary.

dev-bot: note: mute rule set: `mute:alerts:chat-prod-v2:p99` for 30m at 2278901325 by mia.

mia (oncall): leaving a quick post-incident checklist: 1) revert threshold after full stabilization, 2) follow-up PR to improve autoscaler gating, 3) add KV cache warmup on rolling deploys, 4) postmortem with customer timeline. Created ticket: INF-4521.

jordan (support): noted. i've updated the two customers with ETA 2hr and offered temporary routing to other region.

raj (eng-sre): taking over. if we see a p99 bounce after canary rollbacks, plan: 1) increase dedicated pool (scale +2 GPUs in eu-west), 2) enable per-model quantized variant fallback, 3) revert alert threshold to 900ms and enable graduated squelch.

mia (oncall): thanks all. leaving channel. :thumbsup: 

raj (eng-sre): thanks @mia. starting watch. I'll update incident log and set reminder to revert threshold at 2278901620.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed for now (auto). Summary: mitigation applied (canary routing + threshold bump), customers notified, dashboard created. Follow-ups: INF-4521 (autoscaler), INF-4522 (cache warmup), INF-4523 (alerting rework).
